items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you hear some of the r-and-b tenor players like Big Jay McNeely and Sam “the Man” Taylor? [INTERVIEWEE] Not at that time, no.

ctx.x: That’s about right, yeah And I loved – to get to it, I liked the sound of the saxophone. And of course since early rock-and-roll, as you know, had – the saxophone was the main soloing instrument, 8 bars here and there. I liked the tenor. I didn’t even – certainly didn’t know what it was. Nobody in my immediate family – I never saw a tenor. But I liked the sound of it, and I wanted to play that instrument from rock-and-roll, right from the beginning.
Did you hear some of the r-and-b tenor players like Big Jay McNeely and Sam “the Man” Taylor?
